facts.text: Tim attended a Harry Potter-themed party and expressed enjoyment of the event and the people there.

evidence.quote: Hey John! Long time no see! I just got back from the coolest Harry Potter party. Met lots of awesome people who were into the same stuff as me, had so much fun!
Sounds awesome! So glad you had a blast at the Harry Potter party.

facts.text: John mentioned a previous charity event with Harry Potter trivia and expressed enthusiasm for being with like-minded individuals.

evidence.quote: Last August I told you about my fun time at a charity event with Harry Potter trivia. Love being with people who are as passionate about Harry Potter as us!

facts.text: Tim did not dress as a character at the Harry Potter party but wore a Gryffindor scarf and mentioned that others had costumes.

evidence.quote: I didn't dress as any character, but I wore my Gryffindor scarf. Everyone had cool costumes.

facts.text: John mentioned that his basketball team recently played a top team and won after a tough game.

evidence.quote: We played a top team and it was tough, but we fought hard and got the win!
